diagnosis: The TenantApplicationResource directly serializes raw Social Security Numbers and Experian credit scores. Because co-applicants, subletters, and junior leasing agents query the same resource representation, non-underwriting personnel and third parties can intercept highly sensitive personal identification records.

GET /api/real-estate/applications/APP-8104 HTTP/1.1
